unverified.detail: Real call attempted with this personal (non-institutional-master) API key; Kraken rejected it: BadRequest(['EGeneral:Invalid arguments'])

spec.description:
Transfer funds to and from the master account and its subaccounts. Must be called using an API key from the master account. Subaccounts are currently only available to institutional clients.

**API Key Permissions Required:** `Funds permissions - Withdraw`

asset_class.description: Asset class of the asset being transferred.

amount.description: Amount of the asset to transfer.

from.description: Public account ID of the source account (e.g. `ABCD 1234 EFGH 5678`).

to.description: Public account ID of the destination account (e.g. `IJKL 0987 MNOP 6543`).

response.title: AccountTransferResultFrame
response.description: Wire frame; the generated method returns `result`.

error.description: Wire envelope field; see the core.

notes: Institutional master-key only, same gating as CreateSubaccount -- folded into `account` per the brief rather than a `subaccounts` bucket. Kept the `account_transfer` function name (not shortened to `transfer`) despite the subsection already being `account`: Funding already has a same-shaped `wallet_transfer` (Spot<->Futures wallet), so dropping the `account_` prefix here would make the two easy to confuse; `account_transfer` names what actually moves (funds between the master account and a subaccount) unambiguously.
